resources.string: A newer Smylte app is available. This updates the app around Smylte; the app itself is already current.
A newer version of Smylte is ready.
To update itself, Smylte needs permission to install apps. Allow it, then come back.
The installer is open. Smylte closes while it installs; tap Open when it is done. If you cancelled, tap Update again.
Android\'s own installer could not be found, so the update was not opened. Download it from the release page instead.
Saving files is not available in the Android app yet.
The file could not be saved.
No app on this device can open that link.
Smylte needs a newer %1$s. It runs on Chromium %3$d or later, and this phone\'s %1$s is Chromium %2$s. Update %1$s from the phone\'s app store or its system updates, then tap Try again.
Android could not show its unlock prompt. Tap Unlock to try again.
Connect to your Smylte server. The app itself is downloaded from the Smylte release on GitHub and keeps itself up to date; your tasks and calendars stay on your server.
Server address, as you open Smylte in a browser (https://…)

Optional. With a password saved, Smylte signs in by itself whenever its session runs out. It is encrypted with a key that Android\'s keystore holds and never hands out. Leave it empty to sign in on Smylte\'s own screen instead.
Optional, and only useful if update checks hit GitHub\'s limit of 60 requests an hour, which a shared mobile network can reach. A token with no scopes is enough.
The saved password belongs to the old address, so it is not sent to this one. Type it again to use it here, or leave it empty, then save.
GitHub refused this token, so it was not saved. Check it, or leave the field empty.
GitHub refused the saved token, so update checks are running without it. Replace it or leave the field empty.

Asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock when Smylte starts, and when you come back to it after 5 minutes or more. Recents keeps no preview of Smylte while it is on. This applies at once, on this phone only.

Asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock when Smylte starts, and when you come back to it after 5 minutes or more. Recents keeps no preview of Smylte while it is on, and on this version of Android screenshots of Smylte are blocked too. This applies at once, on this phone only.
To lock Smylte, the phone needs a screen lock. Set a PIN, pattern or password in the phone\'s settings first.
